rows.sprk_classificationcue: Fallback classification for any agreement that is clearly a contract between parties creating enforceable obligations, but whose primary subject matter does not clearly match one of the specific registered sub-domains (nda, employment, lease, asset-purchase, services, licensing, vendor, partnership, loan). Use for settlement agreements, novel or hybrid arrangements, multi-subject documents with no single dominant type, or any agreement type not yet given its own registry row. This is the deliberately lower-value, broad-guidance fallback -- never prefer it over a specific sub-domain whose distinguishing characteristics are actually present in the document.

rows.sprk_classificationcue: Agreement whose PRIMARY subject is confidentiality / non-disclosure obligations protecting confidential information exchanged during discussions, due diligence, or a business relationship. Distinguishing signals: a defined 'Confidential Information' term, disclosure/use restrictions, standard exclusions (already known, public, independently developed, rightfully received from a third party), a stated term/survival period, and NO substantive license, sale, service, or employment obligations beyond the mutual promise to protect information. Classify as nda ONLY when confidentiality protection is the document's principal purpose -- not when it is a single clause embedded in a broader deal (e.g. an employment or services agreement that happens to include a confidentiality clause); those route to their own sub-domain instead.
